title: Replacement System Installations Progress Installment: Terms and Homeowner Payment Tool
content:
# Progress installment — Replacement System Installations

## Terms

A project that has been scheduled takes a progress installment from the homeowner ahead of its installation day, and the rest of the balance is due the package's balance-due days after the installation date, where 0 means on the installation day.

The progress installment is the homeowner's own payment toward the project, recorded on the project as a progress payment. It is paid when the homeowner asks to pay it.

## Ledger condition

The progress installment is fixed only after every change order the homeowner has confirmed carries its charge on the project ledger.

Put another way: while any change order the homeowner has confirmed on the project has no charge of its own on the project ledger, the progress installment is not yet fixed.

## Business effect

Paying the progress installment records one progress payment on the project's ledger, dated the day it is paid, by the payment method the homeowner chooses, and lowers the amount the homeowner owes on the project by exactly that amount. The homeowner receives a payment confirmation reference.

## Tool: `pay_progress_installment_728e8d1f`

**Capability.** The homeowner pays the progress installment on their own replacement-installation project: a single progress payment for the amount given, by the method the homeowner chooses, dated today, lowering the amount owed on the project by exactly that amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is the homeowner's own tool. The agent unlocks `pay_progress_installment_728e8d1f` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `install_id` | The reference number of the installation project being paid, given to the homeowner by the agent from the installation project lookup | Text identifier |
| `customer_id` | The reference number of the homeowner's customer profile, given to the homeowner by the agent from the customer profile lookup | Text identifier |
| `amount` | The progress installment the homeowner pays | US dollars, a number with no currency sign, 2 decimal places, always positive, already rounded to the cent |
| `payment_method` | How the homeowner pays | One of `card` (debit or credit card), `ach` (electronic transfer from a checking or savings account), `check` (paper check), `financing` (reserved for funding sent by a financing lender, never the homeowner's own payment) |

**Return.** A receipt with `install_entry_id` (the new payment entry), `install_id` (the project paid), `amount` (2 decimal places), `payment_method` (the method used), `payment_reference` (the payment confirmation reference to give the homeowner), `posted_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `project_balance` (the amount still owed once the payment is applied, or null when the project could not be read). A receipt carrying `payment_reference` means the payment is recorded.

## Points of judgement

- The progress installment belongs to a project that has been scheduled; it is taken ahead of the installation day.
- A homeowner's own progress payment is made by card, ACH or check; `financing` is never the homeowner's own method.
